en: If the information is corrected or deleted, I also request, under § 611(d) of the same Act, that you notify of this change any person or company to whom you have provided my report in the last 6 months — or in the last 2 years, if it was for employment purposes.

es: Asunto: Solicitud de validación de deuda — Cuenta en cobranza
en: Subject: Debt validation request — Collection account

es: Recibí información de que su empresa está intentando cobrarme una deuda. De acuerdo con la Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (15 U.S.C. § 1692g), solicito formalmente que me envíen validación por escrito de esta deuda, incluyendo:
en: I have received information that your company is attempting to collect a debt from me. Under the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (15 U.S.C. § 1692g), I formally request that you send me written validation of this debt, including:

es: - El monto exacto que alegan que debo y cómo se calculó.
- Prueba de que soy la persona legalmente obligada a pagar esta deuda.
- Confirmación de que su empresa tiene derecho a cobrarla.
en: - The exact amount you claim I owe and how it was calculated.
- The name of the original creditor.
- Proof that I am the person legally obligated to pay this debt.
- Confirmation that your company has the right to collect it.

es: Esta carta no es un reconocimiento de que la deuda es válida ni una promesa de pago. Mientras espero esta validación, les solicito que suspendan todo intento de cobro, incluyendo llamadas y reportes adicionales a las agencias de crédito, tal como exige la ley mientras la deuda está en disputa.
en: This letter is not an acknowledgment that the debt is valid, nor a promise to pay. While I await this validation, I ask that you suspend all collection efforts, including calls and any additional reports to the credit bureaus, as the law requires while a debt is in dispute.
